model_annotation: This plot illustrates the change in loss across iterations for different models. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents loss, with a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot features six lines, each representing a different model: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (blue, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (pink, solid). The lines begin at various points near 3.3-3.4 on the y-axis and decrease steadily to around 2.45-2.55 on the y-axis, with no notable peaks or declines, and converge towards the end of the x-axis. Representative values for the lines at the start of the x-axis are approximately 3.35 for Vanilla, 3.32 for StrmLLM (n=64), 3.28 for SepLLM (n=64), 3.27 for SepLLM (n=64, H), 3.25 for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and 3.25 for SepLLM (n=128), and at the end of the x-axis, they are approximately 2.52 for Vanilla, 2.49 for StrmLLM (n=64), 2.47 for SepLLM (n=64), 2.47 for SepLLM (n=64, H), 2.47 for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and 2.46 for SepLLM (n=128).
